reviews.text: Sam and his team did an incredible job, on budget (within reason) and well within the timeline he originally estimated.  He listened to what I was looking for and committed to impress - which he did.  The project involved completely gutting a large den (which had previously been converted from the original garage), half bath, and laundry area, redoing all of the floors and walls, moving a wall, closing a door, opening up a wall to put in sliding glass doors to the patio.  I was nervous about picking a contractor and was initially hesitant about Sam since he seemed young and has a small operation, but I am so glad we went with him.  He absolutely knew what he was doing and managed the small operation well and cost-efficiently!

Sam did a great job managing my project! He installed some nice 9” planks in my home and had some backsplashes installed and it looks great! The flooring took 60 bags of self leveling but every part of the project went smooth and was clean. I will definitely keep using him for future projects.

Sam and his team at Quality Performance Construction are committed to excellent work and equally excellent customer service. They work quickly and efficiently, without cutting corners or compromising quality. They accomplished in four days, what I expected would take at least six: removing an unused balcony; replacing a sliding glass door with a window, including interior and exterior framing, drywall work and painting; and removing, replacing, and painting damaged siding. Any additional unexpected work is discussed and agreed to in advance. I am hiring them again to replace trim around our garage doors. Sam is honest and trustworthy.
